reason: The landlord declined the Pineglass quote of £564.48 (event-017) and chose her own contractor. We stood Pineglass down (event-018, event-020). The £564.48 was never approved: event-012 only asked for approval, and the "approval in force" flag in the code facts is wrong. On 18 Sept the landlord wrote that the work is complete (event-021). That is a claim only, with no date, photos, contractor name or invoice. Oren's "completed" marking (event-022) is a system note and is not proof (closing policy). We asked the landlord for an itemised cost breakdown and any responsibility allocation (event-023) about 6 hours before the decision time, so no reply is due yet. The chase threshold is 3 days. Closing is blocked because our own question is unanswered and the invoice position is unknown. Escalating is not needed: there is no hazard, no dispute, and no sign of fraud, and the property is vacant. The reference-number flag is only the usual suffixes on NBL-028, and both PDFs show the correct address. If the landlord's reply raises tenant charges, deposit deductions or the tenancy account, it must go to a person, because that is never_touch. Event-023 mentioned reviewing the tenancy account, so a person should be aware of that. If there is no reply by about 21 Sept, chase the landlord. Once the invoice position and completion are confirmed, close. The workflow task was dismissed (event-024), so I have set a follow-up to keep the case from being forgotten.
